title: MOD SETTINGS section
author: Cere, made with Claude
description: One MOD SETTINGS row in SETTINGS that opens and closes the rows of Deja Vu, Velocity Humanise and Euclid Accents, so SETTINGS stays short: select it (or turn right) to show them, again (or turn left) to hide them. Starts closed. Without this mod those rows simply show as before.
